svg.title: Architecture: the packages as layers
svg.text: Upper layers call lower ones; every layer writes its facts to the journal, and only Lean, at the right, changes a claim's status.
@seshat/lines: hooks at fixed points of the loop; each one switched on alone and measured
@seshat/registry: manifest, contract, host profile, MCP or in-process; packs at level 2
the loop on pi, budgets, stops,
@seshat/core: events, hash chain, invariants, SQLite projection; @seshat/memory: claims, edges, nodes; @seshat/graph
has run for real (Lean 4.27, a real model)
